## Fit with the project principles

The atlas deliberately does not autoplay anything, does not collect data,
does not guess missing facts and keeps the illustration separate from
navigation (see `PRODUCT.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`). If the idea touches one
of these, say how it stays within them.
